test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ameesha can complete a task by herself in 14 days, while it takes Bhavya 35 days to complete it alone. Together with Chitra, they can complete the task in 6 days. How many days will Chitra need to complete the task alone?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Ameesha to complete a task = 14 days

Time taken by Bhavya to complete a task = 35 days

Together with Chitra, time taken to complete the work = 6 days

**Concept Used:**

Rate of work (Efficiency) = (1)/(Time taken)

Sum of per day tasks of all people = Per day task together

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Chitra takes x days to complete the work.

⇒ Amount of work done by Ameesha each day = (1)/(14)

⇒ Amount of work done by Bhavya each day = (1)/(35)

⇒ According to the formula,

⇒ (1)/(14)+(1)/(35)+(1)/(x)=(1)/(6)

⇒ (1)/(x)+(5+2)/(70)=(1)/(6)

⇒ (1)/(x)=(1)/(6)-(1)/(10)

⇒ (1)/(x)=(5-3)/(30)=(2)/(30)=(1)/(15)

⇒ x = 15 days

**Therefore, the time taken by Chitra to complete the work is 15 days.**
